import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

pw = [0]*20
ans = 10**9

def check(x):
    length = 0
    while x >= 10:
        x //= 10
        length += 1
    return x, length

def dfs(x, cnt):
    global ans
    if cnt >= ans:
        return
    if x == 0:
        ans = cnt
        return
    t, length = check(x)
    # subtract t * repunit(length+1)  (digit t repeated length+1 times)
    dfs(abs(x - pw[length]*t), cnt + t*(length+1))
    if t-1 > 0:
        dfs(abs(x - pw[length]*(t-1)), cnt + (t-1)*(length+1))
    if t > 1:
        dfs(abs(pw[length+1] - x), cnt + (length+2))

def main():
    global ans, pw
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    pw[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, 19):
        pw[i] = pw[i-1]*10 + 1
    ans = 10**9
    dfs(n, 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
